description: This file defines a class DistributionValidations in the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for statistical distribution calculations. It extends a base class for statistical validations and provides a method to validate probability values.

classes.name: DistributionValidations
classes.description: Provides validation methods for statistical distribution calculations, including probability validation.

methods.name: validateProbability
methods.description: Validates that the input probability is a float between 0 and 1 inclusive. Throws an exception if invalid.
